# FF Resonance Atlas

> Free, read-only completion helper for FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE (FF Resonance, Steam / PC, Steam Deck):
> map of the missing Tablet Shards (Fragments de tablette, 99) and treasure chests from the player's own
> save, and counters for the Resonance Rapid Fire (400 Resonances), Keep Them on Their Toes (1000
> staggers), Gil Comes and Goes and Making Lid Proud achievements.

To set it up for a user: clone https://github.com/Aleqsd/ff-resonance-atlas, follow AGENTS.md, run
`python bootstrap.py`, open `work/atlas.html`. Never write to the game, Steam or save folders.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Aleqsd/ff-resonance-atlas/blob/main/README.md): features, setup, safety, limits
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Aleqsd/ff-resonance-atlas/blob/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for AI agents (setup, rules, missing.json format, MCP tools)
- [mcp_server.py](https://github.com/Aleqsd/ff-resonance-atlas/blob/main/mcp_server.py): MCP server (setup_status, refresh_atlas, missing_items, achievement_counters)
